prior_support_rule: B_RING oracle median IoU and median central-hole preservation must both exceed paired FLOW_ONLY medians, and at least one oracle sample must have beta1=1 in the registered target crop
seismic_correction_rule: conditional on prior support, B_RING seismic median IoU and median central-hole preservation must both exceed paired FLOW_ONLY medians and median hard seismic RMSE must decrease
